notation: Y: T_eff x K effective data; K=3; pmax=10; n_c = T_eff - pmax common-sample observations; Sigma_p = MLE residual covariance (divisor = fit observations) of VAR(p); all 'common sample' quantities use rows pmax+1..T_eff exactly as production selectVarLagOrder; 'full sample' fits use production estimateVarModel on all T_eff rows.

metrics.definition: production BIC(p) = log det Sigma_p(common) + ln(n_c)/n_c * (p K^2 + K d), p=1..pmax; d = 1 (constant) or 12 (constant + 11 dummies)
metrics.note: AIC/HQIC are not computed or reported in v1.88

metrics.definition: argmin BIC(p), first minimum on ties (production)
BIC(2) - BIC(1) on the common sample; negative favours lag 2

LR21 = n_c * (log det Sigma_1 - log det Sigma_2) on the common sample (Gaussian quasi-likelihood ratio); descriptive asymptotic chi-square(K^2) p-value reported with the label 'descriptive, not a gate'
K^2 = 9 autoregressive parameters per added lag (K per equation); parameters per equation K p + d and observations per parameter (T_eff - p)/(K p + d) for p=1,2,selected
from the full-sample VAR(2): Frobenius and spectral norms of A_2, and the Wald statistic vec(A_2)' [Sigma_u(df) kron (Z'Z)^-1]_{A2}^-1 vec(A_2) with descriptive chi-square(K^2) p-value
common sample: system share 1 - det Sigma_2 / det Sigma_1, and per-equation partial R^2 1 - SSR_2,i / SSR_1,i
Sigma_u (df-corrected, production sigma_u) and correlation matrix for p=1, p=2 and the selected lag (full sample)
production varStability max root modulus and stable flag for p=1, p=2 and the selected lag (full sample)
production portmanteauTest (adjusted, h=12) statistic, df, p-value and status for p=1, p=2 and the selected lag (full sample)
metrics.caveat: v1.85 showed the asymptotic adjusted Portmanteau is not size-calibrated in these designs (Layer A up to 25% with month dummies); this is reported as the existing production diagnostic, not as a calibrated test

metrics.name: empirical lag-identifiability index (ELI)
metrics.not: not the true psi of v1.87; the estimated VAR is not treated as the known DGP

definition.eli_raw: delta_hat / (K^2 ln n_c / n_c), delta_hat = log det Sigma_1 - log det Sigma_2 (common sample); algebraically eli_raw = 1 - delta_bic_2_vs_1 / (K^2 ln n_c / n_c), so eli_raw > 1 exactly when BIC prefers lag 2 over lag 1
definition.eli_bias_adjusted: (LR21 - K^2) / (K^2 ln n_c), subtracting the chi-square(K^2) null mean of LR21 (overfitting bias)
definition.uncertainty: 90% interval for the noncentrality lambda of LR21 ~ noncentral chi-square(K^2, lambda) by test inversion (lower bound 0 when not identified), mapped to lambda / (K^2 ln n_c)

restrictions: not a probability that p=2 is true

metrics.definition: descriptive nearest-region placement against the frozen v1.87 primary lag-selection surface for the same deterministic specification at T in {132, 144}: weak region psi(T) < 0.5, intermediate 0.5 <= psi(T) < 1.5, strong psi(T) >= 1.5; the unit is described as most similar to the region containing eli_bias_adjusted, and all regions overlapped by the 90% interval are listed; the v1.87 BIC recovery rates of the nearest designs are quoted as synthetic context only
restrictions: not a probability statement about the country's true lag

metrics.definition: A: selected lag 1 and asymptotic h=12 Portmanteau p >= 0.05; B: selected lag 1 and p < 0.05; C: selected lag >= 2 and p >= 0.05; C_fail: selected lag >= 2 and p < 0.05; D (overrides): the selected model is unstable (max root modulus >= 1) or fails the parameter-ratio >= 4 gate
restrictions: underselection relative to a larger estimated model is not equated with misspecification
category is descriptive and does not change readiness

separation.1_lag_identifiability_measurement: bic_grid, delta_bic, LR21, block norms, partial contribution, ELI, v1.87 mapping
separation.2_selected_model_adequacy: selected_model_adequacy_category using the production asymptotic diagnostic
separation.3_bootstrap_diagnostic_evaluation: Phase B only (var_phase_b_bootstrap_protocol.json), separate owner approval
separation.4_production_readiness: unchanged frozen v1.44 readiness; nothing in v1.88 writes readiness

failure_handling: if production blocks a unit, or the Python/production agreement check fails, the unit is reported as 'audit_unavailable' with the reason; no alternative sample, transformation or lag set is tried
